title: Cascading infrastructure failure
summary: Flooding at the Marsh Lane substation cuts power to both pump stations and the water works. Lost pumping raises simulated water levels in Harbor Flats; intervention order matters.
provenance: Synthetic design event authored for the POC. Not derived from observations.
assumptions: Pump stations and the water works depend on the Marsh Lane substation (single-level dependency).
A backup generator keeps one dependent asset powered.
Pump and power state act with a one-hour lag.
known_constraints: One barrier set and one generator are available.
expected_behavior: Without action the substation floods and the cascade removes pumping in Harbor Flats and Riverside. Protecting the substation before its flood hour prevents the cascade; late intervention only partly helps.

params.notes: Utility notes the substation flood door seal is due for replacement.
